lines.text: The sons of Korah recite a love song to the king, saying God has blessed him forever.
The king is told to strap his sword at his side, and his arrows pierce the hearts of his foes.
The king's throne endures forever, and strength is the scepter of his kingdom.
The queen stands at the king's right hand, adorned with the gold of Sheba.
The princess is led to the king in colorful garments, and the nations will praise him forever and ever.
